about_the_game:
Hunkfrat is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you unleash a wide range of stylish combat mechanics to defeat your enemies and reclaim your almighty frat beverages. These legendary drinks are the cornerstone of Hunkfrat’s gym diet, and anyone foolish enough to steal them must pay the ultimate price!

Combat

In Hunkfrat, combat is designed to be dynamic and responsive. Use gunplay, melee attacks, slow-motion, and explosive abilities to take down waves of enemies. Every encounter rewards you with money, which you can then spend to upgrade your character and improve your weapons that make you deadlier within each level.

Progression & Replayability

As you advance, you’ll face increasingly challenging levels, forcing you to combine reflexes with clever use of mechanics. The upgrade system allows you to customize your playstyle—whether you prefer high-damage weapons, agile movement, or powerful area attacks.

Tone & Style

While the action is intense, Hunkfrat doesn’t take itself too seriously. Expect a funny story that make the journey as entertaining as the combat itself.

If you’re looking for a fun, chaotic, and replayable FPS with a mix of humor, upgrades, and fast-paced action, then it’s time to join the fight and protect the frat beverages at all costs!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10-11
  • Processor: Intel I3 10100f / Amd Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce Gtx 1070 8GB / Amd Rx 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
